fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: copied into the `poke` event as it is
fields.description: The player that you poke. The server does not check it. It can be any value, or absent.

confirm.note: The handler reads only `name`, and only to copy it

failures.intro: This handler sends no `game_response`. A success sends only the `poke` event.

rows.when: No character, or you do not wear `poker` in `gloves`.

also.when: Success. Every client whose view holds you, you included.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The `name` from the request, unchanged. Absent when the request has no `name` (JSON drops `undefined`).

fields.name: level
fields.description: From the upgrade level of the gloves: 1 below +8, 2 at +8, 3 at +9, 4 at +10 or more.
